verified_good_products.title: Steel Control Pulpit
verified_good_products.description:
Control pulpits may also be known as control room, operations center or operations control center (OCC) serving as a central space where a large physical facility or physically dispersed service can be monitored and controlled. Prefabricated pulpits are a smart, fast way to expand with limitless possibilities with customized options of floor plans & designs.  These modular control rooms are made up of insulated sandwich panels which helps to main an adequate required temperature for equipment’s.  These Prefabricated pulpits can be liftable type or mounted on civil floor. Pre-engineered or prefabricated control rooms are appropriately designed considering wind speed, seismic zone, equipment loads to withstand harsh climatic conditions and protect sophisticated precious equipment from moisture, air and dust.

Banking on our in-depth knowledge of the prefabricated pulpits, ENGKO as one of the best manufacturers & suppliers of prefabricated control pulpits offers the complete turnkey cost effective solution under one roof right from designing, manufacturing till execution as per customer requirements catering to various industrial sectors like steel plants, furnace area, mining area, power plants, melting shops and heavy material handling area.

 

--------------Additional features of site office-----------

·       Adequate Insulation- Adequate insulation makes prefabricated pulpits suited to maintain required temperature range for equipment’s, control panels & provides healthy working environment to work.

·       Cladding Options- Different cladding options are available as per customer choice like PPGS / PPGS, PPGS / ACP, PPGS / SS, SS / SS for better aesthetic finish.

·       Customizable- 100% customized pre-engineered solutions makes these CRM pulpits available in different sizes & design as per customer need.

·       Accessories- False floors for passing cables/ View glasses, electrical fixtures, ducting work, fire and smoke detectors and firefighting equipment’s.

·       Strong & steady- Reinforced walls & ceilings are strong enough to bear the load of cable trays, equipment’s, smoke detectors, firefighting equipment’s.

·       Zero leakage- Air and water tight to achieve IP54 level protection

No additional cost- Ultimate design gives HSM pulpits a long life with zero maintenance.

image_pattern_summary: Verified good control pulpit images consistently show enclosed prefabricated cabins with large glass visibility panels, installed within active industrial plant environments (steel mills, rolling mills, heavy manufacturing). Products appear as compact-to-medium-sized modular enclosures mounted on elevated steel platforms or ground-level concrete pads, with safety railings and access staircases visible in context shots. Colour schemes vary (green/yellow, grey/orange, white/grey) but the defining visual signature is the glass-panel operator visibility wall combined with an industrial plant backdrop.

Images showing the cabin in its industrial plant context communicate application fit and scale — information that cannot be conveyed by object-only shots.
OCR is not useful here as product images do not carry printed text labels; the visual form and installation context are the primary information carriers.
